nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the token name 'toebeans'.
Public string state variable holding the token symbol 'beans'.
Public uint8 state variable for token decimals (18).
Public uint256 total token supply set in the constructor.
Mapping(address=>uint) of token balances, mutated by transfer/transferFrom.
Nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of allowances, mutated by approve/transferFrom.
Constructor that initializes name, symbol, decimals, total supply and mints all tokens to msg.sender.
View function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using raw unchecked subtraction.
View function returning the balance of a given token owner.
View function returning the remaining allowance of a spender for an owner.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval; returns true.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Transfers tokens from 'from' to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd, deducting the caller allowance, and emits Transfer.
SafeMath addition with overflow require check.
SafeMath subtraction with underflow require check.
SafeMath multiplication with overflow require check.
SafeMath division with division-by-zero require check.
Caller-controlled address used for minting, allowances and balance ownership.
Raw unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] returned by totalSupply().
Unrestricted write of allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without validation.
Balance and allowance state updates in transferFrom, keyed by caller-supplied 'from' address.
Balance state updates in transfer using safeSub/safeAdd on caller balances.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns name during initialization.
Constructor assigns symbol during initialization.
Constructor assigns decimals during initialization.
Constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed initial supply.
Constructor mints the entire supply into balances[msg.sender].
Caller address receives the whole initial supply without any access restriction.
totalSupply() executes the raw subtraction operation.
Unchecked subtraction reads _totalSupply, risking underflow in Solidity 0.5.
Unchecked subtraction subtracts balances[address(0)], a user-influenceable value.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping.
balanceOf returns the looked-up balance.
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping.
tokenOwner parameter selects the owner in allowed mapping.
spender parameter selects the spender in allowed mapping.
allowance returns the remaining allowance.
approve performs an unrestricted allowance write.
Allowance write stores tokens into allowed[msg.sender][spender] without validation.
msg.sender is used as the owner key of the allowance write.
spender parameter is used as the spender key of the allowance write.
tokens parameter is written into the allowance mapping.
approve sets its success return flag to true.
transfer performs balance arithmetic updates.
transfer debits and credits entries of the balances mapping.
'to' parameter is the destination key of the balance credit.
tokens parameter is the value subtracted and added to balances.
msg.sender is the source key of the debited balance.
transfer sets its success return flag to true.
transferFrom performs balance and allowance arithmetic updates.
transferFrom debits balances[from] and credits balances[to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] using caller-supplied 'from'.
'from' parameter is an externally supplied address used as the debit and allowance key without ownership verification.
'to' parameter is the destination key of the balance credit.
tokens parameter is the value moved in transferFrom.
msg.sender keys the allowance that is decremented.
transferFrom sets its success return flag to true.
transfer calls safeSub for balance debits.
transferFrom calls safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
transfer calls safeAdd for balance credits.
transferFrom calls safeAdd for balance credits.
safeSub operand a is the value being reduced.
safeSub operand b is the subtrahend checked by require(b <= a).
safeAdd operand a is the first addend.
safeAdd operand b is the second addend checked for overflow.
safeMul operand a is the first factor.
safeMul operand b is the second factor checked for overflow.
safeDiv operand a is the numerator.
safeDiv operand b is the denominator checked for zero.
transfer uses msg.sender as the owner of the debited balance.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the allowance holder.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter only serves as the balanceOf lookup key, so it is folded into the balanceOf function node.
Owner parameter exists only to index the allowed mapping inside allowance.
Spender parameter exists only to index the allowed mapping inside allowance.
Spender parameter is consumed directly by the allowance write operation in approve.
tokens parameter is the value written by the allowance write operation in approve.
'to' parameter feeds the balance credit performed by transfer.
tokens parameter feeds the balance arithmetic performed by transfer.
'from' parameter supplies the debit key in transferFrom, so it folds into the unsafe state-update operation.
'to' parameter supplies the credit key in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount moved by the transferFrom state updates.
